name: oenod-mobile
description: OENOD for iPhone and Android (Capacitor shell around the OENOD web app).

scripts.add:ios: npm run configure && npx cap add ios && npm run icons && node patch-native.js
scripts.add:android: npm run configure && npx cap add android && npm run icons && node patch-native.js
scripts.sync: npm run configure && npx cap sync && node patch-native.js
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleDebug
